The '''Arden Ring''' was the innermost of the three concentric districts of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. The [[Salis D'aar central archives]] and [[High Court of Bakura]] were located within the district, which was used for public building. The district's street lights were [[Color/Legends|blue-white]], which gave it the nickname of the "'''Blue Ring'''."<ref name="GatORW" />
